card.name: Linking words before infection-risk phrases
card.fires_on: The word "of" or "the" right after "risk" or "because of", mainly in live-vaccine warnings, before "infection". Also a few similar spots before absorption or exposure outcomes.

modes.label: Risk of infection
modes.description: "of" or "the" in "risk of infection" or "because of the risk" in live vaccine warnings.
modes.example: Avoid the use of live attenuated vaccines during and for 2 months after treatment with fingolimod capsules because of the risk<< of>> infection.

modes.label: Possibility of absorption
modes.description: Linking word before an exposure outcome such as absorption through skin.
modes.example: because of the possibility<< of>> absorption of finasteride and the subsequent
